summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus filed by Capital One Funding, LLC for a $2.250 billion Class A(2026-1) Card series note offering under the Capital One Multi-asset Execution Trust. The notes bear 4.48% interest, priced at 99.97676% of par, with an expected issuance date of July 16, 2026 and legal maturity of July 15, 2031. The transaction is a routine asset-backed securities takedown backed by credit card receivables. There are no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or corporate action. The filing is a standard debt offering for securitization purposes.
